_doc: Future backend contracts the V0 mock models so an approved experience can be designed before the backend has it. Each entry names the backend finding in docs/architecture/CONTEXT-RECONCILIATION.md. The mock honours these only when a scenario sets flags.v0; the Legacy reference tier keeps refusing what the backend refuses. A design record that depends on one of these is `conceptual` until the contract lands and the field moves into contract/.

fields.reason: Separate Inventor and Submitted by attribution when a Workspace Admin submits on behalf of an inventor (product-context/WORKFLOWS.md section 5). Null when the primary inventor submitted.
A Workspace Admin selects the real primary inventor when starting an idea on their behalf. Requires idea:create and idea:submit for LEGAL_COUNSEL, which GRANTS does not carry today.

collections.name: emails
collections.reason: The activation and reminder sequences of product-context/WORKFLOWS.md section 9 are V0 requirements; the backend has no mailer. The outbox lets the design show what a person received and why. Nothing is sent.

policies.name: inventor-no-docket
policies.reason: Inventors never see due dates or Actions (product-context/PERSONAS.md, SCREENS.md). The backend serves both to any authenticated role scoped to its client, and production's dashboard shows upcoming due dates to inventors. V0 hides them in the interface; the backend should refuse them so the interface is not the only barrier.
